front: Make a creature regard you as a friend through magic. It attempts a Will save, with +4 if you or allies recently threatened it.
back:
Ends if you use hostile actions against the target. You can Dismiss. Target may not realize it was charmed.
Crit Success: unaffected, aware you tried.
Success: unaffected, thinks it was something harmless.
Failure: attitude becomes friendly (helpful if already friendly); it can't use hostile actions against you.
Crit Failure: becomes helpful; can't use hostile actions against you.
Heightened (4th): lasts until next daily preparations.
Heightened (8th): same, and up to 10 targets.
